estimand.description: Intercept-including point OLS projection of hba1c with focal bmi
estimand.scale: untransformed task output scale, intercept included
estimand.population: CHNS 2009 released-data analytical population: adults aged 35-74 years inclusive, linked person/wave records with documented male/female category and available age, BMI from released height/weight, central-serum glucose and whole-blood HbA1c under the frozen common-complete-case release policy. No diabetes, treatment or pregnancy exclusion is claimed. Age/sex composition is not supplied. This is a selected analytical sample, not a nationally representative population; no participant input.
estimand.measurement: T: task age integer years and documented female/male membership; BMI kg/m^2 from released height/weight; glucose central serum mmol/L; whole-blood HbA1c percent. Cross-context association transfer does not certify assay or specimen equivalence.
estimand.selection: Frozen task common complete-case analytical population; no additional exclusions.
